subject: Urgent: penetration test evidence and scope confirmation for AtlasHealth MAP signature
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@atlashealth.com, security@atlashealth.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Urgent: penetration test evidence and scope confirmation for AtlasHealth MAP signature

Hi team,

We’re in the final contracting window for MAP-8923 and AtlasHealth’s legal/ procurement are requesting penetration test evidence to clear the security gating step before signature. The Atlas timeline they shared internally is: finalize contracts by 2026-11-25, and they need either (a) a copy of the pen test report with redactions or (b) a signed attestation that critical/high findings were remediated and retested.

Quick context: our latest third-party assessment (Q3) was run by WhiteHat (attached executive summary). The full report contains PoCs and some customer-specific IP we won’t publish publicly. We can provide a fully redacted copy today and full report under NDA.

What I need from Atlas to confirm acceptance criteria:
- Is a redacted report + written remediation attestation acceptable for contracting, or do you require the full report under NDA?
- If redacted is acceptable, confirm required fields to preserve (e.g., CVE ids, severity, remediation status).
- If an attestation is acceptable, please confirm the exact wording you need.

Looping in Marissa to assemble the evidence pack and Laura for legal/ attestation language. We’re prioritizing this — let us know by EOD 2026-11-19 so we can meet contracting.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rafael.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147
Redwood Inference

Attachment: vuln-exec-summary-RA-2026.pdf (PDF)
From: procurement@atlashealth.com <procurement@atlashealth.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@atlashealth.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Urgent: penetration test evidence and scope confirmation for AtlasHealth MAP signature

Rafael,

Thanks for the quick note. A few clarifying questions from Procurement/Security: 
1) We typically accept a redacted report for initial contracting, but require a full report under NDA prior to go-live. Can you confirm you can provide a version with PoCs redacted and customer-identifying sections removed?
2) For the attestation, our security team prefers: a signed statement from the vendor that all High/Critical findings have been remediated and retested (include dates and CVE references where applicable). Is that something you can commit to within next week?
3) Also confirm the scope: did the test include the control plane, hosted inference endpoints, and the management console? Our InfoSec asked specifically about endpoints used for model hosting.

We need to have contracting sign-off by 2026-11-25 to remain on this quarter’s procurement cycle. If you can’t meet that, we’ll need to escalate.

Best,
Alex Greene
Senior Procurement Manager
AtlasHealth
procurement@atlashealth.com

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, whitehat@pentestco.com
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 13:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Urgent: penetration test evidence and scope confirmation for AtlasHealth MAP signature

Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround. Short answers inline below, and I’ve attached the redacted report and our remediation tracker for visibility.

1) Redacted report: yes — attached is a redacted PDF that removes PoC payloads and customer-specific identifiers. It includes CVE identifiers, severity, and remediation status. For contracting we recommend this be acceptable. If Atlas requires proof-of-remediation (e.g., retest logs), we can provide that under NDA.

2) Attestation: we can provide a signed remediation attestation. Suggested wording:

"Redwood Inference attests that all High and Critical vulnerabilities identified in the third-party penetration test conducted in Q3 2026 have been remediated and retested as of 2026-11-23. A complete copy of the unredacted report will be provided to AtlasHealth under NDA upon request."

If you need different phrasing, Laura can propose legal language.

3) Scope: the assessment covered the public control plane, management console, and hosted inference endpoints (including API ingress). WhiteHat’s scope doc is captured in the full report (available under NDA).

Attachments included: Redwood_PenTest_Report_v2.3.pdf (redacted), remediation-plan-tracker.xlsx

If that covers it, we’ll sign the attestation and send it by EOD 2026-11-23.

Thanks,
Rafael

> On Thu, Nov 19, 2026 at 10:03 AM procurement@atlashealth.com wrote:

Subject: Re: Urgent: penetration test evidence and scope confirmation for AtlasHealth MAP signature

Hi Alex / Rafael,

Following up with remediation status and timelines from engineering/ security operations:
- High severity (3 items): fixes deployed to staging 2026-11-21; verification tests passed 2026-11-22. Scheduled retest in production 2026-11-24 (coord with WhiteHat).
- Medium severity (6 items): planned remediation window 2026-11-25 to 2026-12-03; these do not block contracting per our internal risk review.
- No Critical (>9 CVSS) findings were reported.

We’ve attached the remediation-plan-tracker.xlsx (spreadsheet) and a short exec extract (vuln-exec-summary-RA-2026.pdf). If Atlas requires evidence of retest, we can provide WhiteHat’s retest sign-off PDF or a test log extract under NDA.

Laura: can you prepare the signed attestation with wording Rafael suggested and include dates and CVE references for the three High items? I will paste the CVE lines into the attestation once Laura produces the draft.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Program Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Marissa / Rafael — this is helpful and appreciated. Two quick asks to keep the contract on schedule:
1) Please send the signed attestation (with CVE references and remediation dates) no later than 2026-11-24 18:00 ET.
2) If you can provide the WhiteHat retest sign-off PDF under NDA by the same time, Procurement can accept contracting clearance and move to signature.

If either of those items will slip beyond that window we’ll need to flag the procurement cycle and escalate to our sourcing director. Otherwise, we’ll proceed on the paperwork side.
